premises.text: Volatile weather creates unpredictable food supply and volatile prices that kill businesses across farmers and food companies
premises.evidence_span: Volatile weather creates unpredictable supply. And unpredictable supply, of course, creates volatile prices. And volatile prices kill businesses

premises.text: Soft commodities are hard to standardize onto exchanges, creating limited hedge coverage and basis risk across countries/currencies
premises.evidence_span: soft commodities are not like gold, and they're not like oil. They're very hard to standardize. And that means you can't get them onto an exchange. Less than 8% of the world's commodities are traded

premises.text: Stable offers a large index insurance platform with thousands of local indexes so businesses can match physical goods risk to a targeted index
premises.evidence_span: Stable has built the world's largest index insurance platform. We have over 3,000 indexes from 40 different countries. And what that means is that you, as a business, can come in and match the risk, the risk of your physical goods, to a local index, highly, highly targeted

premises.text: Index insurance pays out automatically within 48 hours when agreed thresholds are breached
premises.evidence_span: because index insurance means all of this is agreed in advance, so our platform plays out automatically in 48 hours

premises.text: Go-to-market is B2B to corporates and via aggregators (banks, insurers, co-ops) for farmers to solve acquisition cost
premises.evidence_span: we sell B2B to corporate clients, and for farmers, obviously huge cost of acquisition problem, we go through aggregators. That might be banks, that might be insurers, it might be co-ops

premises.text: Pricing uses university-built algos with massive historical simulations, futures ingestion, and automatic portfolio diversification
premises.evidence_span: We run 62 trillion simulations across these indexes to look at the historical prices to predict what will happen in the future

premises.text: Client UX is three simple protection questions with automatic algo pricing and instant certificate
premises.evidence_span: she answers one of three questions. How long do you want to protect your business?

domains.name: Pricing algos and simple buy UX

value.text: Deliver financial confidence by helping food businesses manage supply/price risk simply
value.evidence_span: Stable is delivering financial confidence to our clients

causal_links.evidence_span: match the risk, the risk of your physical goods, to a local index
